<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# All three blocks collected at cols 18-21
# Order: Red (25-28), Blue (31-34), Green (37-40)
# Desired: Red (25-28), Green (31-34), Blue (37-40)
# Need to swap Blue and Green

# Plan:
# 1. Agent is at rows 30-35, overlaps with Blue at 31-34
# 2. Connect to Blue with RIGHT
# 3. Move agent DOWN to ~rows 37-42
# 4. Retract with LEFT - Blue should move to new position

# First, connect to Blue
for i in range(25):
    action(['RIGHT'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
# Check if path connects to Blue
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        if min_r < 50:
            blue_id = n['id']
            has_path = False
            for a in seg['adjacency_list']:
                if a[0] == blue_id or a[1] == blue_id:
                    other = a[1] if a[0] == blue_id else a[0]
                    oc = seg['nodes'][other]['color']
                    if oc in ['g', 'w']:
                        has_path = True
                        break
            print(f"Blue connected to path: {has_path}")
            print(f"Blue position: rows {min_r}-{max(p[0] for p in b)}")

# Check agent position
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        if min_r < 50:
            print(f"Agent: rows {min_r}-{max(p[0] for p in b)}")
</parameter>
</function>
